hero.title: Human Risk Intelligence for Global Mobility.
hero.support_line: Protecting People. Performance. And Your Mobility Investment.
hero.subtitle: MOOVIA combines structured risk assessment, ongoing monitoring and an AI-powered product vision to help organisations identify the human, cultural and family challenges that can compromise international assignments, before they impact performance, retention and business continuity.

rippleDrill.intro: It all starts with an expatriate facing difficulties adapting. It might be a family issue: a spouse who cannot integrate, children struggling at school, social isolation, or simply a growing sense that the move was a mistake.
rippleDrill.family_text: Anxiety grows, motivation drops, concentration deteriorates. Even while still working, they no longer perform as expected.
rippleDrill.team_title: The team starts to feel the consequences.
rippleDrill.team_text: The expatriate delays decisions, delivers less and needs more support from colleagues. The team absorbs additional tasks, collective productivity declines and the working environment deteriorates.
rippleDrill.business_p1_title: Projects start to be at risk.
rippleDrill.business_p1_text: Deadlines are compromised, strategic decisions are delayed, costs rise and important objectives are no longer met. The problem has already gone beyond the expatriate and their team.
rippleDrill.business_p2_text: Delays, execution failures and declining service quality harm the client experience. Contracts may be at risk and commercial opportunities may be lost.
rippleDrill.consequences_title: The company's reputation and results suffer.
rippleDrill.consequences_text: Client dissatisfaction can compromise commercial relationships, future revenue and the organisation's reputation. If the expatriate returns early, replacement costs, loss of knowledge and a new mobility process follow.
rippleDrill.consequences_highlight: The result: a family or individual problem, initially small and potentially solvable, can turn into a business loss far greater than the cost of the assignment itself.

rippleBottom.title: One Human Challenge. Enterprise-Wide Consequences.
rippleBottom.narrative_p1: It starts with an expatriate struggling to adapt.
rippleBottom.narrative_p2: Personal or family difficulties begin to affect focus, motivation and performance.
rippleBottom.narrative_p3: The impact spreads to the team. Productivity declines, colleagues absorb additional responsibilities, and critical decisions are delayed.
rippleBottom.narrative_p4: Projects fall behind schedule. Costs rise. Business objectives are put at risk.
rippleBottom.narrative_p5: Eventually, customers feel the consequences. Service quality suffers, commercial relationships weaken, and the company's reputation and financial performance may be affected.
rippleBottom.narrative_highlight: What begins as a human challenge can become an enterprise-wide business risk.
rippleBottom.narrative_close: MOOVIA identifies the early warning signs, helping companies intervene before the ripple effect reaches their business.

problem_help.title: The Problem & How MOOVIA Helps
problem_help.p1: Immigration, housing and logistics may be on track while employee adaptation, family pressure or organisational challenges put an assignment at risk.
problem_help.p2: MOOVIA combines structured assessments, ongoing monitoring and expert-reviewed intelligence to identify emerging risks and recommend timely action.
problem_help.col1_body: An assignment ends prematurely, creating operational disruption and additional costs.
problem_help.col1_help: How MOOVIA helps: Identifies adaptation difficulties early and recommends support before problems escalate.
problem_help.col2_body: Employees remain on assignment, but unresolved challenges may affect engagement, productivity and performance.
problem_help.col2_help: How MOOVIA helps: Monitors adaptation and organisational factors to identify emerging concerns and recommend interventions.
problem_help.col3_body: Difficulties with family integration, social isolation or cultural adjustment can affect the employee and assignment continuity.
problem_help.col3_help: How MOOVIA helps: Provides confidential family assessments, regular check-ins and personalised guidance.
problem_help.stat_line: For a €150k senior assignee, a troubled international assignment can destroy €300k–€500k in sunk mobility costs, lost productivity, repatriation and replacement.
problem_help.conclusion_line: MOOVIA turns human and contextual information into practical recommendations, giving employees and families confidential support, while providing Global Mobility teams with the insights needed to act.
problem_help.bottom_title: From Human Risks to Business Intelligence.
problem_help.bottom_text: MOOVIA transforms human, family and contextual insights into actionable risk intelligence, helping organisations anticipate problems, make informed decisions and protect assignment outcomes.

privacy_page.title: Privacy and Data Protection
privacy_page.lead: We explain which personal data we process, why, and how we protect it.

who_we_are.title: Who we are
who_we_are.content: The entity responsible for processing personal data is MOOVIA, based in Lisbon, Portugal, contactable via contacto@mooviaglobal.com.

data_collected.title: Data we collect
data_collected.content: We exclusively collect data voluntarily submitted by users through contact, enquiry, and booking forms (such as name, corporate email address, company name, job title, and mobility context details). Regarding technical data, this website does not use tracking cookies or third-party advertising services. Browsing preserves user privacy.

purposes.title: Why we use data
purposes.content: The collected data is exclusively used to: (i) respond to inquiries and provide information regarding MOOVIA and Global Mobility Assurance (based on pre-contractual steps requested by the data subject or legitimate interest); (ii) schedule and conduct introductory and diagnostic meetings with our team (based on pre-contractual steps); and (iii) institutional communication directly related to requested services (based on consent or legitimate interest).

retention.title: How long we retain data
retention.content: Personal data is retained only for the duration strictly necessary to fulfil the purposes for which it was gathered, specifically initial contact follow-up, in accordance with applicable legal retention periods.

sharing.title: Who we share data with
sharing.content: Your personal data is never sold or transferred to commercial third parties. It is shared solely with technological service providers essential to the secure operation of the website and processing of enquiries: cloud hosting and relational database infrastructure (Supabase, adhering to strict security and encryption protocols) and institutional email delivery services. All service providers operate under stringent confidentiality obligations and GDPR compliance.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.content: Under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the right to request access to your personal data, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability, as well as the right to object and withdraw consent at any time. You also hold the right to lodge a complaint with the Portuguese National Data Protection Commission (CNPD). To exercise any of these rights, contact us at: contacto@mooviaglobal.com.

confidentiality.title: Confidentiality and Legal Validation
confidentiality.legal_text: The legal model of MOOVIA was analysed by a leading law firm in Portugal, having been considered legally viable, and is currently in the phase of implementing the identified recommendations.
confidentiality.confidentiality_text: The company receives only aggregated indicators. Individual responses and the employee's personal report remain confidential.
confidentiality.gdpr_badge: Compliant with the General Data Protection Regulation

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.content: MOOVIA reserves the right to update this Privacy Policy at any time to reflect legislative or operational updates. Any material changes will be published on this page with the corresponding updated date.

ai.title: Use of Artificial Intelligence
ai.purpose_text: AI-assisted analysis is used solely to interpret structured responses and present recommendations supporting adaptation and assignment continuity.
ai.minimization_text: We process only the information strictly necessary to monitor the international assignment, avoiding excessive or out-of-context collection.
ai.pseudonymization_text: We apply pseudonymisation and removal of direct identifiers wherever possible, ensuring that analytical processing does not expose the individual's identity.
ai.governance_text: No employment, progression or compensation decisions are made solely on an automated basis from a score. Any recommendation or intervention with human impact is subject to review and validation by human specialists.

team_page.title: Built on decades of experience, united by one conviction: the human side of international mobility deserves the same protection as the investment behind it.
team_page.p1: MOOVIA was born from a decades-long friendship and two career paths that crossed in the international corporate world, spanning Revenue Assurance, major consultancies, and enterprise technology, alongside first-hand experience of the human challenges of international mobility.
team_page.p2_prefix: After years of protecting corporate investments in processes and revenue, we saw an opportunity to apply the same rigour, evidence, and accountability to one of the most critical yet often overlooked aspects of international assignments:
team_page.p3: Today, our multidisciplinary team brings together expertise in global mobility, behavioural science, technology, business strategy, and corporate governance, united by one conviction: the human factors that determine the success of international mobility deserve the same attention and protection as the financial investment behind it.
team_page.team_subtitle: The team coordinating your journey. Lean, multidisciplinary, by design.

hero.title: Bringing the discipline of assurance to international mobility.
hero.paragraph: MOOVIA was created to give the human side of an international assignment the same attention as the financial and operational investment behind it. We combine structured assessment, specialist insight and follow-up to help employees, families and organisations navigate international transitions.
hero.caption: Human experience • Evidence • Action

origin.title: From Revenue Assurance to Global Mobility Assurance.
origin.p1: MOOVIA was born from decades of high-stakes consulting in Revenue Assurance, risk management, and digital transformation across multinational corporations.
origin.p2: In telecommunications, banking, and energy, Revenue Assurance is an established discipline: systematically preventing financial loss, ensuring operational integrity, and recovering value before leakage becomes structural.
origin.p3: We realized that the greatest unmanaged risk in international business today is not financial systems or supply chains, it is the human transition. Millions are invested in moving key people across borders, with almost zero systematic protection for the personal, family, and operational friction that causes assignments to fail. We created Global Mobility Assurance to close that gap.

cards.c1_text: Structured audits, systematic controls, and battle-tested processes.
cards.c2_text: An obsessive focus on preventing value leakage and safeguarding investment.
cards.c3_text: Built to navigate the complexity and governance of large multinational organisations.
cards.c4_text: The track record of Mindset Consulting and its founding team across sectors and geographies.
cards.c5_text: Technology and method serving the most decisive and vulnerable element: the person.

origin.tagline: The discipline of Revenue Assurance. The empathy of human transition.

approach.title: Three principles guide our work.
approach.paragraph: MOOVIA combines human understanding, structured intelligence and responsible information-sharing to support international assignments throughout their journey.

cards.c1_highlight: Understanding people beyond the relocation process.
cards.c1_text: Every international assignment involves personal, professional, cultural and family challenges. Through structured assessments, meaningful conversations and regular check-ins, we understand how people are adapting, what support they need and how their circumstances evolve.
cards.c2_highlight: Turning human insights into informed action.
cards.c2_text: We connect relevant signals over time to identify emerging risks, protective factors and changes in adaptation. Explainable criteria and AI-assisted analysis support our specialists in interpreting these patterns and recommending appropriate interventions, as these capabilities are developed and validated.
cards.c2_extra: Technology supports the analysis. Human expertise guides the decisions.
cards.c3_highlight: Personal support and corporate visibility, with privacy at the centre.
cards.c3_text: Employees and families receive confidential assessments, personalised guidance and ongoing support. Companies receive relevant assignment-level indicators, trends and recommended actions, without unnecessary access to personal or family information.
cards.c3_extra: This allows MOOVIA to support individuals while helping organisations make better-informed mobility decisions.

how_we_fit.title: We complement the existing global mobility ecosystem.
how_we_fit.p1: MOOVIA does not replace relocation providers, HR teams or specialist services. We complement their work by focusing on what happens beyond the practical move: how employees and families adapt, integrate and progress throughout an international assignment.
how_we_fit.p2: By connecting human and contextual insights over time, MOOVIA helps identify emerging challenges, recommend appropriate interventions and support better coordination between the people and organisations involved.
how_we_fit.p3: We connect human experience with corporate decision-making, helping companies protect their international mobility investment while supporting the people behind it.
how_we_fit.distinction_title: The distinction to Global Mobility Management.
